 What happened to Naz Reid? Live injury updates for Hornets at Pistons on Wednesday 10/28/26 
 NBA 
 News 
 Published: 
 October 28, 2026 
 By: 
 Stan Son 
 Charlotte Hornets forward Naz Reid did not start the second half of Wednesday’s game against the Detroit Pistons. He is not in foul trouble and no injury has been reported. In addition, Reid is on the Hornets bench, but not playing. Royce O’Neale started the second half for Reid.
 Naz Reid not on the floor to start the second half, Royce O'Neale taking his place. He's on the bench and stripped ready to go, not sure what that's about. *]:mx-auto lg:[&>*]:mx-0"> 
— James Plowright (@British_Buzz) October 29, 2026 
 Reid had seven points, six rebounds and a block in 13 first-half minutes.
 Stay tuned to DraftKings Network for live updates on his status.
